spans.s:
For प्रशस्य is also substituted ज्य when the affixes इष्ठन् and इयसुन् follow.

Terms: इष्ठन् and इयसुन्

The semi-vowel of ज्या 'to grow old' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

Terms: सम्प्रसारणम्

आ is substituted for the first letter of ईयस् after ज्य।

Terms: Some substitution
